attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited has approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results during a meeting held on 13 November 2026. The Limited Review Reports were issued by statutory auditor Walker Chandiok & Co LLP. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 20,587.28 million and a profit after tax of 866.68 million. For the six-month period ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 33,623.91 million with a profit after tax of 1,878.11 million. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee. The company's CIN is U13691WB1994PLC064637. The NSE symbol is SENCO.

attchmntText: Senco Gold Limited has informed the Exchange about Earnings Conference Call for Q2 FY27
voiceSummary: Senco Gold Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call for Monday, 16th November 2026, at 11:00 A.M. IST. The call will follow the declaration of standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September 2026. The company will be represented by Mr. Suvankar Sen, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, and Mr. Sanjay Banka, Group Chief Financial Officer and Head of Investor Relations. The schedule is subject to change. Details are available on the company website.
